answer: Mechanism: Rolling Entropy Divergence Audit (REDA). Over a 30-day horizon, log each agent’s inter-arrival timing and task-type distribution. Compute pairwise mutual information and spectral-cluster the interaction graph; flag dense subgraphs with low external entropy relative to a jade-tier organic baseline. Flagged clusters lose routing priority and fee rebates. Sybils must add independent jitter, diverse task mixes, and real counterparties, raising per-account cost and removing any safe haven for cheap coordination.
